contract: PATCH /api/items/:id/cover rejects in this order: no token 401, unknown item 404 (before the permission check), no library access 403, no update permission 403, and a body without cover 400, changing nothing. PATCH cover with a path that is one of the item's scanned library files validates the path (not http, a scanned file of the item, existing, a file, a supported image) and, when the stored coverPath is a different path, copies it to metadata/items/:id/cover.<ext>, removes older cover images of the item, purges the resized cache, sets media.coverPath, moves updatedAt and emits item_updated; the answer is {success:true,cover}. PATCH cover with a path equal to the stored coverPath answers 200 with that path without copying, purging the cache, moving updatedAt or emitting item_updated. PATCH cover answers 500 and changes no row, file or cache entry when the path is not a scanned file of the item, is an http url, is a scanned text file (Invalid image), or has disappeared from disk; a JSON body above the 10 MB express.json limit is rejected with 413, while a 1.1 MB body is parsed and reaches the handler.
exceptions: force is not applicable: the route has no force or override mode; selecting another scanned image replaces the cover.
The cover copy is only asserted with the default storeCoverWithItem=false setting; the storeCoverWithItem=true branch is the same copy code with an item-folder destination.

invariants.contract: PATCH /api/items/:id/cover rejects in this order: no token 401, unknown item 404 (before the permission check), no library access 403, no update permission 403, and a body without cover 400, changing nothing.

PATCH cover with a path that is one of the item's scanned library files validates the path (not http, a scanned file of the item, existing, a file, a supported image) and, when the stored coverPath is a different path, copies it to metadata/items/:id/cover.<ext>, removes older cover images of the item, purges the resized cache, sets media.coverPath, moves updatedAt and emits item_updated; the answer is {success:true,cover}.
Repeating PATCH cover with the same scanned path when the stored coverPath is the metadata copy copies it again, moves updatedAt and emits item_updated again.
PATCH cover with a path equal to the stored coverPath answers 200 with that path without copying, purging the cache, moving updatedAt or emitting item_updated.

PATCH cover answers 500 and changes no row, file or cache entry when the path is not a scanned file of the item, is an http url, is a scanned text file (Invalid image), or has disappeared from disk; a JSON body above the 10 MB express.json limit is rejected with 413, while a 1.1 MB body is parsed and reaches the handler.
PATCH cover parses JSON bodies up to the express.json 10 MB limit (a 1.1 MB body reaches the handler and answers 500 invalid path) and rejects a larger body with 413 without changing the item.
